console.title: Console
console.subtitle: Run django_dbs commands as your own account, with what your role allows. Jobs a command starts run on, and you can follow them here.
console.terminalOnly: Commands that read files on the manager's computer, or ask for a secret other than your password, are not offered here. Run them in a terminal on that computer.
console.empty: Nothing run yet. Type help, or a command such as server list.
console.hint: Enter runs it. Up and Down go back through what you ran.

password.title: Run with your password
password.body: This command acts for real, so it needs your password: {command}

errors.console_busy: Your previous command is still running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.unbalanced_quotes: Close every quote in the command.
